name: v205_generic_guidance_actual_residual
hypothesis: Generic company guidance and actual fields are high-coverage and low-crowding, but direct generic revision vectors were high-corr. This version asks whether actual-vs-guidance gap plus guidance range compression under a low market-correlation regime carries a different timing path.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_60_days_spy < correlation_last_360_days_spy, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actual_af_v4_nd_actual - anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate, 63), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Fresh generic guidance surface. Reject if it maps to generic analyst vector blockers (`1Y7Z77YX`, `O0p8JGJq`) or produces unit warnings / weak metrics.

name: v205_detail_previous_estimate_latency
hypothesis: The previous-estimate fields may capture revision latency. Unlike earlier direct generic vector tests, this uses current-minus-previous estimate and actual-minus-previous in a low-SPY-correlation timing regime with no sales/EPS/BVPS named parent.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_60_days_spy < correlation_last_360_days_spy, 0.310 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate - anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_previosestimate, 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual - anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_previosestimate, 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate - anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: A stricter timing variant of generic analyst revision latency. Do not repair by small window tweaks if it is high-corr to `MPpGzqwr` or generic analyst actives.

name: v205_longterm_revision_compression
hypothesis: Long-term estimate-current minus previous estimate is nearly unused and could reflect slow expectation anchoring. A pure LT revision compression signal may avoid named EPS/sales/detail estimate parents.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_lt_v4_nd_estimate - anl4_fs_detail_lt_v4_nd_previosestimate, 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_lt_v4_nd_estimate - anl4_fs_detail_lt_v4_nd_previosestimate), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Low-use LT revision surface. Stop if it repeats v183 LT weakness or LSUS fragility.

name: v205_acquisition_cash_absorption_largecap
hypothesis: Acquisition payment fields are low-use and economically meaningful: cash-efficient acquisitions and lower purchase outflow may imply disciplined capital allocation. Large-cap and low-correlation timing are used to avoid old goodwill/AQI acquisition clusters.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank((gross_payments_for_acquisitions - net_payments_for_acquisitions) / abs(acquisition_total_purchase_value), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_payments_for_acquisitions / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * business_acquisition_payments_net / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * acquisition_related_expenses / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.090 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: One cold footnote probe; not a goodwill/AQI rescue. Stop if weak like v164 acquisition cash absorption or high-corr to acquired-goodwill actives.

name: v205_generic_lowrange_guidance_sparse
hypothesis: Companies giving narrow generic guidance ranges with stable point estimates may have lower operational uncertainty. This tests range compression without actual/estimate subtraction dominance.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.65, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance), 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate, 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_estimate, 63)), 126), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.090 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.070 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Range-only generic guidance ablation. Reject if it merely recreates ordinary low-risk/quality exposure.

name: v205_comp_earnings_lowcorr_nocashflow
hypothesis: Competitor/earnings/cashflow is crowded, but previous success came from changing trading regime and removing cashflow. This tests a stricter no-cashflow, low market-correlation version with no raw cashflow_op sleeve; it is included as the single probability-preserving legacy probe.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_60_days_spy < correlation_last_360_days_spy, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.100 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.070 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.030 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Strict-check against `A1wrAX3E`, `E5w8oepG`, `O0pNbJ17`, `Vkp0P130`, and `6Xwo83wP`; do not submit if top corr is near or above 0.68.
